scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducibility are provided; self-review are not independent peer review.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-position, two-layer ON/OFF Markov generator; positive site weights, unit OFF hopping, symmetric rate s, stationary oriented bond current. No claim about generic switched graphs, unequal flashing rates, or independent historical validation. The 2018 switched-sawtooth literature comparison remains open.
title: A sharp universal switching-rate window and direction rigidity in a three-site flashing ratchet
